initial_application: The Jira snapshot records a short GH#1caaa7803c application reference, but that abbreviated hash was not present in the current checkout or GitHub commit lookup. The current core source no longer has a literal Sequence example page; it has a shared example template that delegates the conformance sentence to a publisher macro.
additional_context: Zulip discussion showed the issue affects all resource examples and that Grahame Grieve directed the task to FHIR publishing. Current source/fhir.ini lists Sequence under removed resources, while current CI pages such as Patient and Observation still render the same profile wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR source edit was made because the template only calls <%example.profile.link%>; the macro implementation in HL7/kindling hard-codes profile before the StructureDefinition name.
